verdict.rationale: Lovable's docs say that from a single description it generates a working app with frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations. Its auth feature generates login pages and wires them to the backend, and its database feature creates tables and schema from a chat description. Hands-on users confirm it builds full CRUD tools and app scaffolding, though they report mediocre code quality. Missing for 10: independent evidence of backend logic beyond the Supabase-based Cloud, such as custom edge-function business logic, and evidence that the generated backend is production-quality (users report loose typing, single-file code and poor caching/performance).

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate both frontend UI and backend logic from a single prompt

citations.quote: You describe what you want to build, and Lovable generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations, all backed by editable code.
Ask Lovable to add login, and it generates the signup and login pages, wires them to your backend, and protects user data with row level security.
Describe the data your app needs in chat, and Lovable creates the tables and schema for you.
Lovable hosts your app and includes a built-in backend (Cloud) with database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and AI, no infrastructure setup required.
